_comment: Delta patch for knowledge/graph/agentic_universe_graph.json. Generic node/edge shape — adapt to agentic_universe_schema.json and validate with tools/knowledge_graph.py before applying. Dedupe nodes if earlier patches already added them.

nodes.label: Cost‑utility control
nodes.summary: Real‑time caps, anomaly detection, per‑tool cost tags; hard session caps, exponential backoff, max iteration limits; measure cost vs aggregate task utility.

nodes.label: Schema governance
nodes.summary: Explicit tool output schemas; validate on ingress/egress; version agent APIs; treat structured outputs as untrusted until validated.

nodes.label: HITL UX & approval fatigue
nodes.summary: Approval dashboards with evidence panels, one‑click overrides, timeout→reject semantics; instrument abstain rates and queue age; design for rejection, not just approval.

nodes.label: Agent identity & federation
nodes.summary: SPIFFE‑like agent identities, DPoP, Workload Identity Federation; attenuated delegation chains; centralize agent registries for multi‑tenant governance.

nodes.label: Runtime verification
nodes.summary: Temporal logic policies (Dogwood/Cedar+temporal); proof‑carrying patches; runtime attestation (TRACE, IETF RATS/EAT, in‑toto, SCITT); instrument evidence outside agent boundary.

nodes.label: Physical & edge agents
nodes.summary: Physical safety layers (Anthropic MHS); digital twins as world models; edge runtimes for latency‑sensitive or region‑bound workloads.

nodes.label: Red‑team & forensics
nodes.summary: Executable red‑team exercises (REDAgentBench, MiDojo, DeepTeam); trace debugging, first‑divergence analysis; NIST‑aligned IR runbooks for agent incidents.

nodes.label: Privacy & lineage
nodes.summary: Runtime evidence for residency/GDPR; agent registries with lineage tracking; deploy agents close to data; centralize only metadata/performance signals.
